blocks.text: Mayon Volcano remains under Alert Level 3 days after its moderate explosive eruption, as Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) is continuing to monitor volcanic activity and warning the public to stay away from the permanent danger zone.
